final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet, mirror to tail
MB  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=0.5
MT  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=30 L=0.5
* NMOS input pair (vinp = non-inverting)
M1  d1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=12 L=0.3
M2  vout  vinn  tail vss nfet W=12 L=0.3
* PMOS mirror load (diode on M1 side)
M3  d1    d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=25 L=0.5
M4  vout  d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=25 L=0.5
.ends dut
